seoTitle: Course Schema Generator With CourseInstance Schedule
metaDescription: Build Course JSON-LD with provider and course instances: online or onsite, start and end dates, weekly workload and instructor.
intro: Builds Course markup with provider and one CourseInstance per run, each with mode, schedule, workload and instructor.
why:
Each run of a course is a CourseInstance with its own dates and delivery mode. Write one instance: line per run and the tool builds the schedule, and turns a workload such as 3h/week into a repeat frequency and an ISO 8601 duration.

Google retired the course info result in 2025; course list carousels still use name, description and provider. The tool says so and checks those three.
howTo: Enter the name, description and URL.
Enter the provider as Name | URL.
Add instance: lines with mode, dates, workload and instructor.
Copy the script tag onto the course page.

faq.a: 3h/week becomes a weekly schedule and PT3H; a plain duration like 20 hours also works.

faq.q: Does Google still show course results?
faq.a: Course info was retired. The list carousel remains; see the notes in the output.

faq.q: Can a course have several instances?
